quote: I want to be useful or bring enjoyment to all people, even those I’ve never met.
source: Anne Frank, The Diary of a Young Girl, the entry of 5 April 1944, the Definitive Edition (trans. Susan Massotty, 1995)

evidence.where: Open Library search inside, which returns the sentence from the scan of the Definitive Edition itself and from Mirjam Pressler’s Anne Frank: A Hidden Life, Pressler being the co-editor of that edition
evidence.edition: The Diary of a Young Girl: The Definitive Edition, ed. Otto H. Frank and Mirjam Pressler, trans. Susan Massotty, Doubleday, 1995
evidence.locator: the entry headed Wednesday, April 5, 1944, near its close, just before I want to go on living even after my death

reason: The Massotty wording matches word for word across the scan of the Definitive Edition and several independent books that quote it, and the same scan shows the entry heading Wednesday, April 5, 1944. The older Mooyaart-Doubleday translation reads give pleasure to people around me, so naming Massotty is what makes this wording honest. Anne Frank stands at two for the year, so this is her third and last line.
